name: Virgin Snow Ura ~Yukifuru Oka de Anata to~
original_name: Virgin SNOW　裏～雪降る丘であなたと～
source:
In addition to remastered previous game content and full voicing there is new male main character perspective in addition to Mizuki Narumi perspective at former female perspective scenes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
除了重制前作内容并加入全程配音，本作还新增了男性主人公视角；此前采用女性视角的场景中，除了鸣海瑞希的视角外，现在也会呈现男主人公的视角。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-march-2005-parfait-chocolat.html]vndbreview[/url]]
